reason: My boys already send me a photo and a voice note on WhatsApp for free, and I phone them anyway. For twenty technicians that is about four thousand rupees a month, every month, to replace something that costs me nothing today.
objection: My technicians will not keep pressing any button after the first week, whatever language it listens in. Once the setup person leaves, I will be paying per head for an app half of them have stopped opening.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month at least most of my technicians are still sending reports without me chasing them, and the price comes down to a flat amount for the whole team instead of per technician.
